content_of_post_to_comment: A polyglot once told me the biggest difference between successful language learners and everyone else was embarrassment tolerance. Years later, after panicking in bakeries, pubs, offices, and several conversations about music, I think it might be the most accurate language-learning advice I’ve ever heard.
comment: Embarrassment tolerance is fascinating because it may be less about confidence and more about accepting a temporary loss of identity. You stop protecting the image of being competent long enough to actually learn.
